stories.title: Coeur d'Alene Police determined the "unexploded device" to be a commercial firework
stories.summary: A report of a possible explosive device caused evacuations in Belmont and Appaloosa around 5 p.m. Monday.

stories.title: Thousands without power in the Spokane area Monday evening
stories.summary: A car crash caused power outages across Cheney, Four Lakes, and the Spokane Airport area Monday evening, according to Inland Power and Avista.

stories.title: In the shadow of the Old Trails Fire, Washington AG announces new effort to strengthen state arson laws
stories.summary: The legislation would create an aggravated arson charge, spurred after the state's most destructive urban wildfire on record was intentionally set August 1.

stories.title: Holidays and Heroes food and donation drive set for November 21
stories.summary: The annual food and donation drive will take place at Barney's Harvest Foods from 8 am to 5 pm.

stories.title: Spokane County unanimously votes against raising property tax revenue
stories.summary: At Monday's public hearing, the Spokane County Board of Commissioners also declined to enact three new property taxes.

stories.title: Megadeth Farewell Tour coming to Spokane
stories.summary: Thrash metal legends Megadeth are bringing their Farewell tour to the Numerica Veterans Arena in September 2027.

stories.title: The long paw of the law: Bonners Ferry introduces K-9 program
stories.summary: Ava Wion dreamed of becoming a police K-9 handler when she was a little girl. Today, the Bonners Ferry police officer is on the cusp of making that dream a reality.

stories.title: Rathdrum mom battling breast cancer, insurance denial has died
stories.summary: Sabrina Dilday lost her battle with triple-negative breast cancer on Thursday, November 12, according to her husband Jeffrey.

stories.title: '196 too many': Idaho advocates push for safer roads, remember victims of deadly crashes
stories.summary: An advocate is turning his own family's experience into a decades-long effort to make roads safer.

stories.title: Nationwide ground stop prompts questions from Seattle travelers about aging air traffic systems
stories.summary: A telecommunications failure grounded U.S. flights for hours Friday, with officials investigating a new router's role in the incident.

stories.title: New Spokane Valley Trader Joe's feeling the love on opening day
stories.summary: The new store at 13414 E Sprague Ave. opened Monday morning to a crowd and cheers.

stories.title: KSD approves research phase for potential City Hall move
stories.summary: Discussions between the city of Kellogg and the Kellogg School District over the future of the empty wings of the district's Administrative Annex building will move
